text:
Maya Chen: Kicking off RedLeaf Therapeutics onboarding thread — want to capture stakeholders, success criteria, 30/60/90 timeline, enablement plan, and any renewal risks. Proposed kickoff call Wed 3/25 10:00am PT. Who from our side can own infra handoff + EU compliance checklist?

Javier Ortiz: I can take metrics + evals ownership. I'll prepare a baseline dashboard in Console. +1 to Wed 10am.

Priya Nair: I’ll own enablement (training docs + playbook). Need product access for their devs and a short workshop slot. Wed 10am works for me.

Samir Patel: I’ll own infra handoff and Private/VPC setup. Need RL's network contact and IP allowlist. I can run the design session after kickoff.

Maya Chen: Draft success criteria (please comment):
1) p95 generation latency < 200ms on their expected traffic profile
2) Pilot cost < $X per 1k tokens (to be confirmed with finance)
3) KV/prefix caching enabled for their common prompts
4) Data isolation confirmed for EU-regulated data and KMS integration

Javier Ortiz: +1. I'll add metric targets to the dashboard and wire up traces.

Priya Nair: Enablement checklist items I’ll deliver: onboarding guide, 2x 60-min workshops, runbook for common errors, Q&A doc.

Samir Patel: Noted. Risk: their legal needs EU data-residency paperwork signed before Private deploy — could add 2–3 week delay. Marking as high-risk until signed.

Maya Chen: Good call. I'll add "EU legal signoff" to the renewal/watchlist as a potential delay risk.

Priya Nair: Cadence proposal: 30-min weekly standup (Mon 9am PT) + ad-hoc tech sync after kickoff. Thoughts?

Javier Ortiz: Monday standups sound good. I suggest we sprint against a 30/60/90 milestone plan.

Maya Chen: Proposed 30/60/90 (draft):
```
30 days: infra + IAM + basic integration tests; enablement session 1; dashboard baseline
60 days: pilot with 10k calls/day; performance tuning; enablement session 2; cost report
90 days: SLA handoff, go/no-go decision, rollout plan + renewal checkpoint
```

Samir Patel: Works for infra. I'll schedule a design call week 1 to confirm IPs, firewall, and KMS flow.

Javier Ortiz: Action: I'll create the Console dashboard and share a link before kickoff.

Priya Nair: Action: I'll draft the enablement plan and a short survey to capture RL's primary use cases and top 10 prompts for eval.

Maya Chen: Action items (assigning):
- Maya Chen: run kickoff call Wed 3/25 10am PT; collect RL stakeholder list and legal POC
- Javier Ortiz: console dashboard + eval metrics (due in 3 business days)
- Priya Nair: enablement playbook + survey (due in 5 business days)
- Samir Patel: infra design call + Private deploy checklist (schedule by EOD Fri)
- All: flag any blockers in this thread or DM me

Javier Ortiz: I'll follow up with calendar invites and an initial dashboard link. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: I’ll post the survey draft here once ready.

Samir Patel: Scheduling infra design call — invite sent to eng-platform and security.

Maya Chen: Tagging @onboard-bot to create the onboarding ticket and track these action items.

onboard-bot: Ticket #CS-6291 created for RedLeaf onboarding. Owner: Maya Chen. Due: 2026-04-01. Labels: onboarding, private-deploy, high-risk-eu.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — will post kickoff agenda and RL stakeholder list before the call.

Javier Ortiz: Ready on my end.

Priya Nair: Ready.

Samir Patel: Ready.
